subject: general
question: The Constituent Assembly formed the Drafting Committee to prepare a Draft Constitution of India on:
solution:
The correct answer is __**29th August 1947**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The Constituent Assembly of India was formed in 1946 to draft the Constitution of India.
 
• The Drafting Committee was one of the most significant committees formed by the Constituent Assembly.
 
• Dr. B.R. Ambedkar was appointed as the Chairman of the Drafting Committee.
 
• The Drafting Committee was formed on 29th August 1947 to prepare the draft of the Indian Constitution.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Constituent Assembly:**

 
 
• The Constituent Assembly was a body of representatives elected to draft the Constitution of India.
 
• It was formed under the Cabinet Mission Plan of 1946.
 
• The Assembly had 389 members, which later reduced to 299 after the partition of India.
 
• It was presided over by Dr. Rajendra Prasad.
 
 
 
• **Drafting Committee:**
 
 
• The Drafting Committee was one of the eight major committees formed by the Constituent Assembly.
 
• It was responsible for drafting the text of the Constitution.
 
• Dr. B.R. Ambedkar, known as the principal architect of the Indian Constitution, was the Chairman of this committee.
 
• The committee included other prominent members like Alladi Krishnaswami Ayyar, K.M. Munshi, and Muhammad Saadullah.
 
 
 
• **Dr. B.R. Ambedkar:**
 
 
• Dr. Bhimrao Ramji Ambedkar was an Indian jurist, economist, politician, and social reformer.
 
• He was the principal architect of the Indian Constitution.
 
• He served as the first Law and Justice Minister of independent India.
 
• Dr. Ambedkar played a key role in framing the Constitution, ensuring the protection of fundamental rights and social justice.
 
 
 
• **Key Dates:**
 
 
• The Constituent Assembly held its first meeting on 9th December 1946.
 
• The Drafting Committee was formed on 29th August 1947.
 
• The final draft of the Constitution was adopted on 26th November 1949.
 
• The Constitution of India came into effect on 26th January 1950, celebrated as Republic Day.
